entities.summary: The Red Fićo, officially Fićo gazi tenka! is a monument in Osijek, Croatia. It commemorates the destruction of a Zastava 750 car by a Yugoslav Army tank at the start of the Croatian War of Independence, an event that became a symbol of Croatian resistance. The monument, unveiled in 2011, depicts a Soviet-made T-55 tank seemingly sinking into the ground while being run over by a red Zastava 750.
